changelog: Tenancy Agreement Generator v2.7.6: Added Landlord Entity selector (Individual property owner/s with NRIC vs Company with SSM Registration No.), added Tenant Entity selector (Individual with NRIC vs Corporate Tenant with SSM No., registered address, email & phone), added Authorized Contact Person details for corporate tenants (Full Name, Designation, NRIC No. & Mobile/WhatsApp No.), updated legal Preamble, Schedule 1 and Execution/Signatures block for corporate representation, and updated WhatsApp/Email templates with direct contact routing.
